from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u020/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ccf97962.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Choose the isolated 3x3 object containing the greatest number of colors.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    remaining = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0}
    objects = []
    while remaining:
        start = remaining.pop()
        stack = [start]
        cells = [start]
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            for dr, dc in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                q = (r + dr, c + dc)
                if q in remaining:
                    remaining.remove(q)
                    stack.append(q)
                    cells.append(q)
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 == 2 and c1-c0 == 2:
            objects.append([[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1+1)] for r in range(r0, r1+1)])
    return max(objects, key=lambda obj: len(set(v for row in obj for v in row)))
''')
